1.title: The Stolen Updraft
1.premise: A repair apprentice stranded in a city of floating rooftops can temporarily copy one function from a broken magical device, but only after understanding why it failed. She wants to turn a condemned flying cart into an entry for an outlaw race whose prize is an abandoned workshop. A rival apprentice wants the same prize and has independent plans. Let growing understanding make previously impossible maneuvers possible. The first useful repair must remain useful later; do not reset her to incompetence. Leave the origin of the copying ability unresolved through the opening arc.

2.title: The Mountain Circuit
2.premise: A disgraced courier enters a mountain racing circuit where competitors build their own movement skills.
